blurb.en: The Pratihāra line's praśasti under Bhoja: Nāgabhaṭa II's conquests, and the Pāla 'lord of Vaṅga' defeated.
blurb.hi: भोज के अधीन प्रतिहार वंश की प्रशस्ति: नागभट द्वितीय की विजयें, और पाल 'वंगपति' की हार।

reading: Nagabhata II defeated Chakrayudha and also con- quered kings of the Anartta, Turushka, Malavo, Vatsa, Matsya and other countries

blurb.en: Amoghavarṣa I's copper plates of 871 CE, recounting his father Govinda III's wars from the Himalaya to Kāñcī. Their Sanskrit is not quoted here; the OCR garbles it.
blurb.hi: अमोघवर्ष प्रथम के 871 ई. के ताम्रपत्र, उनके पिता गोविन्द तृतीय के हिमालय से कांची तक के युद्धों का वर्णन। उनका संस्कृत यहाँ उद्धृत नहीं; ओसीआर उसे बिगाड़ देता है।

reading: The water of the springs of the Himalaya mountains was drunk by whose horses
